analysis_role: Secondary pre-existing-artifact cross-check while the independent aza3 HybPiper rerun is pending.

intersection.limitation: The 125-locus intersection is bounded by the 176-locus accepted Japan38 tree partition set, not by focal C. sieboldii target recovery. The independent aza3 HybPiper rerun is expected to test a broader focal locus set.

alignment_method.primary_identity: informative aligned A/C/G/T pairs only; N-containing aligned positions excluded
alignment_method.secondary_identity: raw identity treating N as mismatch
alignment_method.sequence_preparation: C. sieboldii partition segments extracted from concatenated alignment and '-' gaps removed; N retained for missingness accounting.

claim_boundary: Strong coding-sequence compatibility does not establish chromosome-coordinate concordance, local ancestry, haplotype age, structural-variant reuse, genomic modularity, or genotype-phenotype association.
